name: Open Deep Research (smolagents)
description: Hugging Face's open replication of Deep Research: a smolagents agent that browses and reads files to answer hard questions.
whatItDoes: Given a question, it searches the web, navigates pages, inspects documents and writes an answer. It reaches 55% on the GAIA validation set and serves as a reference for research agents.
howItWorks: A code-writing manager agent delegates to a text-browser search agent and file-inspection tools from the smolagents library. It is run from a script with a chosen model id.

requirements.name: SERPER_API_KEY
requirements.description: Web search; SERPAPI_API_KEY is the alternative

models: OpenAI o1 by default; other models supported by smolagents
